_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values so extracted.

clinicians.basis: Dell Med clinicians in the lab

half.basis: clinicians // 2, the size of each arm

ama_2026_pct.basis: percent of doctors using AI in practice, the release citing a 2026 AMA survey

ama_2023_pct.basis: percent reported in 2023, the release citing the AMA

ama_base_year.basis: the earlier year the release compares with

questions.basis: count of the researcher's quoted questions
